periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: High-contrast black eye patches exhibit a downward and inward tilt toward the rostrum at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with an approximate visual width-to-height ratio of 1:1.8.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The geometric center is shifted toward the upper-outer quadrant, with a distinct tapering narrowing toward the inferior point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the transverse band follows a broad, flat U-shape across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band covers approximately 40-50% of the visible vertical torso height from the shoulder to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the dark semicircular pinnae is approximately 2.5 times the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears exhibit smooth, convex, semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent rufous or brownish-red fur coloration is localized to the abdominal and inguinal regions, contrasting with the standard white ventral fur.
